# Interferon response summary (mixed)

Differential expression analysis showed activation of the interferon program. IFI6 was upregulated (Table 1). ISG15 was upregulated in the treated arm (Table 1). MX1 was upregulated in IFN-treated PBMCs (Table 1). OAS1 was downregulated relative to control (Table 1).

The proinflammatory cytokines TNF and IL6 were downregulated (Table 1). STAT1 was upregulated as expected (Table 1).
